data.action: 变身光效环绕，星尘升起
data.description: 【深森白夜 · 月夜屋顶变身】高楼林立的城市天台之巅，清冷的满月洒在白夜的身上，璀璨的星尘光环如银河般从她脚下升腾而起，将她单薄的身躯包裹进神圣的变身光芒之中。她回眸望向你，目光纯粹而神圣——「恶之参谋先生……无论你的身份是什么，今晚的月光，都只属于我们两个人。」
data.promptProse: On a rooftop above closely packed city towers, Byakuya turns toward the viewer as stardust rings rise from around her feet. Her pink-and-white magical dress, detached sleeves and fairy wings remain intact inside the transformation glow. The wide view shows the rooftop edge beneath her and full moon beyond the buildings. Magic light brightens the lower frills and wand, while cool moonlight outlines her shoulders against the night skyline.
data.title: 深森白夜 · 月夜屋顶变身
